messages.text: Looked up for Sarah: Magic Miner 40T, $799, Batch 6, ships Nov 21 2026. At under 12¢, power runs roughly $29 a month; best value per terahash we sell.
Looked up for Sarah: 40T is a single-ASIC BM1370 desk unit, about 15 lb shipped, $40 flat shipping bracket — fine for an office; no numbers beyond that confirmed.

Hey, I'm Sarah! At about ten cents the Magic Miner 40T costs around $47 a month to run. It's $799, and it draws for a full block every ten minutes. Would it run on a desk, or somewhere out of the way? Tap an answer, or the mic and tell me.
Looked up for Sarah: Confirmed: 650W at 40 TH/s, so ~$47 a month at 10¢. Eco mode is 30 TH/s at 450W, about $32 a month, ~50 dB — desk-friendly.
At your rate that's about forty-seven dollars a month in power. At six fifty watts it also puts out heat like a small space heater. Is that okay for your office?
Great. It's seven ninety-nine, it's in Batch 6 and ships November twenty-first. The A. to cart button is right there on the page. Want to grab one? (The call ended. 2 shopper turn(s). Reply NOTHING.)
